verdict.rationale: A runtime npm probe shows @babylonjs/core is published under Apache-2.0, a permissive open-source license with no royalty or per-install terms. The docs also describe Babylon.js as an "open game and rendering engine". missing for 10: first-party licensing documentation explicitly stating no royalties or per-install fees, independent or community corroboration of commercial use without fees, confirmation that all packages (not just core) share the license.
